title: Cursor pagination and order normalization
description: Repair behavior across a pagination utility and order-service mapping.
feedback: The orders export drops records when a page is short and duplicates overlapping records. The provider says nextCursor alone indicates whether another page exists; even an empty page can have a next cursor. fetchAll must pass {cursor, limit} to the callback, start with cursor undefined, and stop only when nextCursor is null/undefined/empty. A repeated cursor must reject rather than loop forever. listOrders must preserve the first occurrence of each order ID in source order (ID 0 is valid), expose totals in dollars from integer totalCents, and avoid mutating provider objects. The callback API and listOrders export must remain unchanged.
evaluationNotes: Only workspace, feedback, ownerPreferences and visible checks go to the coding worker. Hidden tests and reference files are evaluator-only.
